sections.layout:
## Agent layout

- This file is also `AGENTS.md` (a symlink) and `.agents/skills` points to `.claude/skills`, so
  Claude Code and Codex read the same instructions and skills. Edit `CLAUDE.md` and
  `.claude/skills/` only; never replace a link with a copy (copies drift).
- This file is the inventory and the routing map: "Skills" below says which skill applies and which
  does not, "When to Invoke" routes a task. Deep content lives in each skill's `SKILL.md` and its
  `references/`.
- The user's own skills follow the same shape (positive and negative applicability, a References
  table) and get a row in "Own skills" outside the managed sections: `/workspace-setup`.
sections.profile:
## Profile

- cashU profile `synthetic`. Its data comes only from the MCP server `cashu-synthetic`
  (configured in `.mcp.json`).
- Modules enabled: none (net worth only). Base currency: PLN.
- cashU CLI for commands the user runs in their own terminal: `/synthetic/cashu --profile synthetic ...`
- Talk to the user in Polish. Files for agents are in English. Regular hyphens only, never the em
  dash character.
- Managed by cashU 1. Text between the `cashu:begin` / `cashu:end` markers is
  rewritten by "Aktualizuj workspace" (Ustawienia > Agent AI) or `/synthetic/cashu workspace update --profile synthetic`.
  Write your own instructions outside the markers.
sections.privacy:
## Privacy level

- Level when this file was written: **strict** (Ścisły, default): you see shares in percent, percentage points, dates, categories, merchant names and public tickers / ISINs. No amounts, account numbers or personal names. Do not ask the user for amounts; use relative units (percent of the portfolio, months of expenses).
- The live level is `profile_overview` (`privacy`); when it differs from this file, the live
  level wins.
- In both levels accounts appear as generated labels ("<institution> <type> <n>") and private
  payees as `payee:` references. Every MCP call is logged in the app (Ustawienia > Agent AI).
- The level covers what the app's MCP tools give you. Files or rows the user hands you themselves are
  their choice: use them for the task they asked for.
sections.tools:
## MCP tools (server `cashu-synthetic`)

Use only this server, never another profile's.

- core: `profile_overview`

Write tools record a decision, thesis, note or category, or store a proposal the owner approves in
the app. The list follows the enabled modules; `.claude/settings.json` allows exactly these tools.
sections.boundaries:
## Boundaries

- Data only through the MCP tools above. Never read, list, copy or parse these places of the app
  (cashU data dir, database, backups, import archive):
  - `<ROOT>/data`
  `.claude/settings.json` denies Claude Code's file tools there. Bash commands ask the user
  first: never propose one that reads those places.
- Files in `inbox/` are the user's: open one when the user hands it to you or asks you to. Do not
  copy its values into `notes/`, memory, scripts or git; keep them in the conversation. Account
  numbers, IBANs and names you see there are never repeated or written anywhere.
- Never run cashU CLI commands that print personal data (`stats`, `accounts`, `import-dir`,
  `import-csv`, `invest positions`, `invest import`, `loans list`, `eb login|check|sessions|resync`).
  Give them to the user to run in their own terminal, not with `!` in this session.
- Not a licensed advisor. Model recommendations are opinions for the owner to evaluate, never
  decisions or orders. No price predictions. Facts that change are looked up online with a source;
  never bypass paywalls, logins or bot protection.
- Never ask for passwords, logins, SCA / 2FA codes, API keys, IBANs or account numbers. If the user
  pastes one, do not repeat or store it.
- Personal or financial data never goes into git repositories, memory files or code; working notes
  stay in this workspace.
sections.files:
## Where things go

- `notes/`: working notes (interview state, situation, retrospective, special situations;
  `/investments-setup` uses `notes/interview/`). English; in strict mode relative values only,
  unless the user agreed to note amounts.
- `research/`: working files of research runs (source lists, drafts). Results go to the app with
  the research MCP tools.
- `scripts/`: converters and helper scripts you write (Python standard library only). You run them
  with a Bash command the user approves; the app never runs them.
- `connectors/`: connectors you write (`connectors/<id>/`; the contract is
  `.claude/skills/import-builder/references/connectors.md`); `test_connector` tests one in the
  sandbox on a sample from this workspace (value-free report, nothing installed), `propose_connector`
  submits one. Before writing one, check the community catalog shipped with the app (`connectors()`
  lists it): `propose_connector(catalog_id=...)` installs an entry the same way. The app runs one on
  the owner's data only after the owner approves it in Ustawienia >
  Konektory.
- `inbox/`: the user saves exports here (renamed if the file name holds an account number). Open
  one when the user hands it to you; with the blind route `inspect_export` shows its masked
  structure. Converter output goes to `inbox/converted/` and is deleted after the owner commits the
  import.
- `.claude/skills/`: the skills cashU manages (below) plus your own skills, which cashU never
  touches.
sections.skills:
## Skills

Managed by cashU (inventory only; each skill's `SKILL.md` frontmatter is the source). A skill of a
module you switch off is removed on the next update; a managed skill you edited is kept and
reported instead of being replaced.

(none for the enabled modules)
sections.research:
## Weekly research

The investments module is off for this profile: no research routine.

sections.skills:
## Skills

Managed by cashU (inventory only; each skill's `SKILL.md` frontmatter is the source). A skill of a
module you switch off is removed on the next update; a managed skill you edited is kept and
reported instead of being replaced.

| Skill | Module | Applies to | Does not apply to |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/workspace-setup` | core | the task / case | NOT unrelated. |
| `/market-research` | investments | the task / case | NOT unrelated. |

## When to Invoke

| Situation | Skill |
|---|---|
| First session in this workspace (no `notes/workspace-setup.md` yet), before any module setup; adding, converting or fixing the user's own skills or instructions | `/workspace-setup` |
| The Saturday research routine, a note on an instrument, segment or macro, a thesis review, a candidate (also early-stage, hyper-growth or SPAC) with entry conditions | `/market-research` |
| Any question about the profile's data | the MCP tools above, never files |
sections.research:
## Weekly research

- Run `/market-research` on Saturday, before the Sunday review, or whenever the user asks.
  Scope: held positions, the watchlist, candidates matching the strategy, sector and macro trends.
  Results go to the app as notes with sources through the research MCP tools.
- The Saturday run is a LOCAL routine in this folder (the cashU MCP server runs on this Mac;
  `/schedule` creates cloud routines that cannot reach it): Claude desktop app > Code > Routines >
  New routine > Local, weekly, Saturday 07:00, folder = this workspace, instructions
  `/market-research rutyna`. Alternative for terminal users: a LaunchAgent the user installs that runs
  `cd <ROOT>/workspace && claude -p '/market-research rutyna'`.
  Set it up only after the user approves the schedule; never silently.
- Unattended permissions (opt-in, Ustawienia > Agent AI): **off**.
  Every web search, web page and file write asks first, so an unattended run stops at
  the first prompt; the user can switch it on in Ustawienia > Agent AI.
- Research notes contain facts and sentiment with sources only (community sentiment flagged as
  noisy). Recommendations are saved separately and never place trades. No price predictions;
  never bypass paywalls or bot protection.

<!-- cashu:begin layout -->
## Agent layout

- This file is also `AGENTS.md` (a symlink) and `.agents/skills` points to `.claude/skills`, so
  Claude Code and Codex read the same instructions and skills. Edit `CLAUDE.md` and
  `.claude/skills/` only; never replace a link with a copy (copies drift).
- This file is the inventory and the routing map: "Skills" below says which skill applies and which
  does not, "When to Invoke" routes a task. Deep content lives in each skill's `SKILL.md` and its
  `references/`.
- The user's own skills follow the same shape (positive and negative applicability, a References
  table) and get a row in "Own skills" outside the managed sections: `/workspace-setup`.
<!-- cashu:end layout -->

<!-- cashu:begin profile -->
## Profile

- cashU profile `synthetic`. Its data comes only from the MCP server `cashu-synthetic`
  (configured in `.mcp.json`).
- Modules enabled: Investments (`investments`). Base currency: PLN.
- cashU CLI for commands the user runs in their own terminal: `/synthetic/cashu --profile synthetic ...`
- Talk to the user in Polish. Files for agents are in English. Regular hyphens only, never the em
  dash character.
- Managed by cashU 1. Text between the `cashu:begin` / `cashu:end` markers is
  rewritten by "Aktualizuj workspace" (Ustawienia > Agent AI) or `/synthetic/cashu workspace update --profile synthetic`.
  Write your own instructions outside the markers.
<!-- cashu:end profile -->

<!-- cashu:begin privacy -->
## Privacy level

- Level when this file was written: **strict** (Ścisły, default): you see shares in percent, percentage points, dates, categories, merchant names and public tickers / ISINs. No amounts, account numbers or personal names. Do not ask the user for amounts; use relative units (percent of the portfolio, months of expenses).
- The live level is `profile_overview` (`privacy`); when it differs from this file, the live
  level wins.
- In both levels accounts appear as generated labels ("<institution> <type> <n>") and private
  payees as `payee:` references. Every MCP call is logged in the app (Ustawienia > Agent AI).
- The level covers what the app's MCP tools give you. Files or rows the user hands you themselves are
  their choice: use them for the task they asked for.
<!-- cashu:end privacy -->

<!-- cashu:begin tools -->
## MCP tools (server `cashu-synthetic`)

Use only this server, never another profile's.

- core: `profile_overview`

Write tools record a decision, thesis, note or category, or store a proposal the owner approves in
the app. The list follows the enabled modules; `.claude/settings.json` allows exactly these tools.
<!-- cashu:end tools -->

<!-- cashu:begin boundaries -->
## Boundaries

- Data only through the MCP tools above. Never read, list, copy or parse these places of the app
  (cashU data dir, database, backups, import archive):
  - `<ROOT>/data`
  `.claude/settings.json` denies Claude Code's file tools there. Bash commands ask the user
  first: never propose one that reads those places.
- Files in `inbox/` are the user's: open one when the user hands it to you or asks you to. Do not
  copy its values into `notes/`, memory, scripts or git; keep them in the conversation. Account
  numbers, IBANs and names you see there are never repeated or written anywhere.
- Never run cashU CLI commands that print personal data (`stats`, `accounts`, `import-dir`,
  `import-csv`, `invest positions`, `invest import`, `loans list`, `eb login|check|sessions|resync`).
  Give them to the user to run in their own terminal, not with `!` in this session.
- Not a licensed advisor. Model recommendations are opinions for the owner to evaluate, never
  decisions or orders. No price predictions. Facts that change are looked up online with a source;
  never bypass paywalls, logins or bot protection.
- Never ask for passwords, logins, SCA / 2FA codes, API keys, IBANs or account numbers. If the user
  pastes one, do not repeat or store it.
- Personal or financial data never goes into git repositories, memory files or code; working notes
  stay in this workspace.
<!-- cashu:end boundaries -->

<!-- cashu:begin files -->
## Where things go

- `notes/`: working notes (interview state, situation, retrospective, special situations;
  `/investments-setup` uses `notes/interview/`). English; in strict mode relative values only,
  unless the user agreed to note amounts.
- `research/`: working files of research runs (source lists, drafts). Results go to the app with
  the research MCP tools.
- `scripts/`: converters and helper scripts you write (Python standard library only). You run them
  with a Bash command the user approves; the app never runs them.
- `connectors/`: connectors you write (`connectors/<id>/`; the contract is
  `.claude/skills/import-builder/references/connectors.md`); `test_connector` tests one in the
  sandbox on a sample from this workspace (value-free report, nothing installed), `propose_connector`
  submits one. Before writing one, check the community catalog shipped with the app (`connectors()`
  lists it): `propose_connector(catalog_id=...)` installs an entry the same way. The app runs one on
  the owner's data only after the owner approves it in Ustawienia >
  Konektory.
- `inbox/`: the user saves exports here (renamed if the file name holds an account number). Open
  one when the user hands it to you; with the blind route `inspect_export` shows its masked
  structure. Converter output goes to `inbox/converted/` and is deleted after the owner commits the
  import.
- `.claude/skills/`: the skills cashU manages (below) plus your own skills, which cashU never
  touches.
<!-- cashu:end files -->

<!-- cashu:begin skills -->
## Skills

Managed by cashU (inventory only; each skill's `SKILL.md` frontmatter is the source). A skill of a
module you switch off is removed on the next update; a managed skill you edited is kept and
reported instead of being replaced.

| Skill | Module | Applies to | Does not apply to |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/workspace-setup` | core | the task / case | NOT unrelated. |
| `/market-research` | investments | the task / case | NOT unrelated. |

## When to Invoke

| Situation | Skill |
|---|---|
| First session in this workspace (no `notes/workspace-setup.md` yet), before any module setup; adding, converting or fixing the user's own skills or instructions | `/workspace-setup` |
| The Saturday research routine, a note on an instrument, segment or macro, a thesis review, a candidate (also early-stage, hyper-growth or SPAC) with entry conditions | `/market-research` |
| Any question about the profile's data | the MCP tools above, never files |
<!-- cashu:end skills -->

<!-- cashu:begin research -->
## Weekly research

- Run `/market-research` on Saturday, before the Sunday review, or whenever the user asks.
  Scope: held positions, the watchlist, candidates matching the strategy, sector and macro trends.
  Results go to the app as notes with sources through the research MCP tools.
- The Saturday run is a LOCAL routine in this folder (the cashU MCP server runs on this Mac;
  `/schedule` creates cloud routines that cannot reach it): Claude desktop app > Code > Routines >
  New routine > Local, weekly, Saturday 07:00, folder = this workspace, instructions
  `/market-research rutyna`. Alternative for terminal users: a LaunchAgent the user installs that runs
  `cd <ROOT>/workspace && claude -p '/market-research rutyna'`.
  Set it up only after the user approves the schedule; never silently.
- Unattended permissions (opt-in, Ustawienia > Agent AI): **on**.
  Web searches, web pages and writes to `research/` and `notes/` run without a prompt
  (`.claude/settings.json`), so an unattended run can finish.
- Research notes contain facts and sentiment with sources only (community sentiment flagged as
  noisy). Recommendations are saved separately and never place trades. No price predictions;
  never bypass paywalls or bot protection.
<!-- cashu:end research -->

User note stays.
